style: Minimal, UI-born. The supplied coral / green light-streak gradient is the stage and keeps moving the whole time; the lockup is typed in like a text field and its caret becomes the V4 chip.
font: none (wordmark, pill and V4 traced from the supplied still)

customize.note: Hand-authored: the registry's gradient blocks (mesh-gradient, flowing-gradient) generate their own colours; this piece needed the user's own gradient plate driven by a timeline-seeked WebGL shader, and a caret-to-pill morph no block covers.

content.logo: data/logo.json (traced glyphs) + assets/plate.png (gradient with the logo painted out)

shots.motion: light streams in along the streaks out of the dark; long-exposure smear settles; camera eases out of a slight zoom and roll
caret wakes and blinks once; 'Eleven' streams in letter by letter (blur 10px -> 0, x -14 -> 0) as the caret steps past each glyph
caret fills out into a solid capsule, then opens into the pill ring (power4.inOut) while the word slides left to make room; fill dissolves into the outline
V and 4 rise inside the ring (expo.out, staggered 80 ms)
press (scale 0.955, back.out release), one hairline ripple, one ring of light through the gradient
hold; gradient keeps drifting with soft bands of light running up the streaks
